verdicts.V1: V1 THE CORRECTED a0_c.  With the G167-collapsed deep end a0_eff = 1.08-1.10e-10 (a0_eff/a0_DE = 1.154-1.175, not the staircase's 1.3-2.0), the composite a0_eff = sqrt(a0_Lambda x a0_c) gives a0_c = a0_eff^2/a0_Lambda = [1.2459e-10, 1.2925e-10] m/s^2, midpoint 1.2691e-10 +- 2.65e-12 (2.1% from the a0_eff band doubled + a nominal 1% on a0_DE), = [1.331, 1.381] x a0_Lambda (1.33-1.38x, mid 1.356x).  The M/L collapse (G167) cut G166's partner by 1.23x-1.28x (SPARC-band input) and buried the 3.63e-10 MIGHTEE-end partner entirely -- the corrected composite partner is 1.24-1.29e-10, ON the committed SPARC RAR band (1.20-1.2457e-10), not the underived 1.6-1.8x mystery G166 left open.
verdicts.V2: V2 THE NEAREST-REGISTERED CANDIDATE.  a0_c (corrected) = 1.246-1.292e-10; the nearest registered quantity is the L232 SPARC free-fit scale a0 = 1.2457e-10 (fable_independent_2026/L232_sparc_parameter_free.py: n = 2, free scale s/s_Lambda = 1.3305, implied a0 = 1.2457e-10 = the G133-committed RAR band top): a0_c_lo / L232 = 1.00016 -- the composite partner's low edge coincides with the SPARC free-fit optimum to 0.02%, so the corrected composite is SELF-REFERENTIAL: sqrt(a0_DE x a0_RAR_hi) = 1.07991e-10 = the observed deep-end low edge 1.08e-10 (ratio 0.99992).  Registered rationals in band: (4/3) a0_DE = 2 s_Lambda/3 = 1.2483e-10 (0.9981 at the low edge, G189's own L232 match at 0.2% carries over); sqrt(a0_DE cH0/4) = 1.2376e-10 (1.0067); the dwarf cross-convention Ystar-0.36 value 1.2560e-10 and the dwarf low-mass free-fit bin 1.2640e-10 +- 3.15e-11 sit inside the band (ratio ~1.01).  NOT candidates: h67b (a stellar-import convention, no a0), G03D EFE-boosted 5.00e-11 (5/2 x it = 1.25e-10 hits the low edge at 0.3% but the EFE boost was REJECTED, G166), and G189's staircase-era table-mates s_Lambda = 2a0_DE, sqrt(2)a0_DE and a0_DE/Omega_Lambda -- all tuned to the dead 1.84e-10 rung, all outside the corrected band.  Nearest registered = L232 (ratio 1.00016-1.0375).
verdicts.V3: V3 THE HONEST STATEMENT -- the composite scale after the artifact removal: a0_c = 1.2459e-10-1.2925e-10 = (1.33-1.38) x a0_Lambda, i.e. the composite partner collapsed from G166's 1.54-1.66e-10 (1.64-1.77x) onto the committed SPARC RAR band, matching (4/3) a0_DE to 0.2% and the L232 free-fit scale to 0.02%; the composite closes on itself (deep end = sqrt(DE x RAR-hi) to 0.02%).  The residual tension -- deep-end RAR-class 1.08-1.10e-10 vs the DE anchor 9.3619e-11, +15-17.5% (+0.062 to +0.070 dex) -- now registers at 2.2-2.5 sigma statistical-only and ~1.9 sigma with the M/L-convention spread folded in (G167's own residual +0.040 dex at Ystar 0.6): MARGINAL, not significant, and far below the staircase's 5.2 sigma.  The footing crisis's true remaining size: a ~1.5-2.5 sigma, ~15% normalization preference for the RAR-class scale over the vacuum scale at the deep end, plus the SPARC band's own 1.28-1.33x reading -- compressed from G166's 1.3-2x crisis to a ~1.2-1.3x strain at ~2 sigma, and the z ~ 2.5 BTFR zero point (G080: 0.00 vs +0.33 dex, 20:1) remains the decisive instrument for the rung.
